description: The tutorial editor window alone: the editor_* session commands (open a staged capture into a session, read its snapshot, execute a command, close the session, hide the window), the durable save/list/reopen commands (save a project, list every project on disk, reopen one by id) and the workspace view-preference commands (read/write the sanitized selection/playhead/panel-layout/theme blob, never the project's revision or history), the media-URL lookup (the absolute path of a REGISTERED asset or product only, for the preview) that build.rs's app manifest takes out of every other window's reach, plus the file dialogs its save/import flows need. No other capability grants any allow-editor-* permission.
